children.value: avivekāspadā bhraṣṭāḥ kaṣṭe rūḍhā na satpade
hastādapagamitāḥ sarve sāṃsārikāḥ pāramārthisvavivekamātreṇārdhaprabodhādardhamutsṛjyārdhaṃ ca gṛhītvā'vacalitācalitenāntaravaṣṭambhena me matiḥ

svata eva cañcalamābhogi nānābhogavāsanāvistīrṇaṃ bhuvanāntarviharaṇena ca
dṛḍhābhyastacāpalamato balānnigṛhyamāṇamapi tattvajñānāvaṣṭambhāato'tucchamanāyāsamanupādhi gatabhramam
kiṃ tatsthitipadaṃ sādho yatra śoko na vidyate
na bandhaṃ kathamāpnoti padmapatre payo yathā
kiṃ tasyāducitaṃ śreyaḥ kiṃ tatsyāducitaṃ phalam
tattvaṃ kathaya me kiṃcidyenāsya jagataḥ prabho
bhṛśaṃ daiśikaparicchedaprāpyāntaḥ pūrṇatāṃ pūrṇo na śocāmi yathā punaḥ
kadarthayantīha bhṛśaṃ vikalpāḥ śvāno vane dehamivālpajīvam
